# Context interactions

The exact 13 published event names come from the five context-local `events.qnt` files. Consumer sets follow the relationships in specs/README.md; event-specific subsets are still assumptions. Every documented event has a declared emitter and at least one chart with an explicit reception transition. The product map stores upstream direction in `meta.relationships`; its parallel regions preserve context independence.

| Event | Upstream / emitter charts | Interpreted downstream contexts | Contract disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SignedIn | Identity; [account-sign-in](contexts/profile/lifecycles/account-sign-in/machine.yaml) | Billing, Spaces, Friends, Chess, App, Journeys, Auth | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| SignedOut | Identity; [account-privacy](contexts/profile/flows/account-privacy/machine.yaml), [account-sign-in](contexts/profile/lifecycles/account-sign-in/machine.yaml) | Billing, Spaces, Friends, Chess, App, Journeys, Auth | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| UsernameChanged | Identity; [username-changes](contexts/profile/lifecycles/username-changes/machine.yaml) | Spaces, Friends, Chess, App, Journeys | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| AccountDeletionConfirmed | Identity; [account-privacy](contexts/profile/flows/account-privacy/machine.yaml) | Billing, Spaces, Friends, Chess, App, Auth | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| PaidAccessStarted | Billing; [membership-and-checkout](contexts/billing/flows/membership-and-checkout/machine.yaml) | Spaces, Chess, Journeys | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| PaidAccessEnded | Billing; [membership-and-checkout](contexts/billing/flows/membership-and-checkout/machine.yaml) | Spaces, Chess, Journeys | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| SpaceOpened | Spaces; [hosting-and-joining](contexts/spaces/flows/hosting-and-joining/machine.yaml) | Friends, Chess, App, Journeys, Developer tools | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| PersonJoined | Spaces; [hosting-and-joining](contexts/spaces/flows/hosting-and-joining/machine.yaml) | Friends, Chess, App, Journeys, Developer tools | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| PersonLeft | Spaces; [hosting-and-joining](contexts/spaces/flows/hosting-and-joining/machine.yaml) | Friends, Chess, App, Journeys, Developer tools | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| SpaceEnded | Spaces; [hosting-and-joining](contexts/spaces/flows/hosting-and-joining/machine.yaml) | Friends, Chess, App, Journeys, Developer tools | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| BecameFriends | Friends; [friendship](contexts/friends/lifecycles/friendship/machine.yaml) | Spaces, Chess, App, Journeys, Developer tools | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| FriendshipEnded | Friends; [friendship](contexts/friends/lifecycles/friendship/machine.yaml) | Spaces, Chess, App, Journeys, Developer tools | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |
| MatchFormed | Matchmaking; [matching](contexts/matchmaking/lifecycles/matching/machine.yaml) | Chess | Name matched; source-to-consumer registration and state-specific reaction need owner approval. |

The following relationships publish vocabulary but have no exact event contract: App → Identity and Developer tools; Developer tools → App; Chess → Journeys; Auth provider mechanics → Identity outcome. No substitute event name has been invented. Code topics/outbox messages are adapters until owners approve their relation to the published facts.

## Every potentially affected state

This is a conservative matrix: every non-excluded state in each consuming context may be using identity, access, social visibility, space presence or match facts. Some historical developer reports should show no change. An absent handler is a question, not an implicit transition. Both the upstream owner and downstream owner must approve each unresolved reaction, especially while a modal or provider checkout is open.

## Code names requiring a contract adapter review

These code identifiers are not silently renamed into published domain events. Engineering must identify the existing adapter or confirm that the message is private bookkeeping. Product owners must approve any public counterpart.

| Code identifier | Source | Published counterpart / gap | Owners |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| friend.request.accepted / FriendRequestAccepted | [friend-events.ts](../../libs/friends-shared/src/friend-events.ts), [friends-outbox-messages.ts](../../libs/friends-shared/src/friends-outbox-messages.ts) | BecameFriends describes the settled friendship; the notification request event is a different delivery contract. | Friends + downstream owners |
| friend.removed / friend.blocked | [friend-events.ts](../../libs/friends-shared/src/friend-events.ts) | FriendshipEnded is the public fact; blocked-person UI must not learn the private cause. | Friends + Spaces + Chess |
| BlockChanged | [friends-outbox-messages.ts](../../libs/friends-shared/src/friends-outbox-messages.ts) | No exact published event covers blocking a stranger; invitation and opponent restrictions need an approved boundary contract. | Friends + Chess + Matchmaking |
| SpaceRenamed | [space-log-messages.ts](../../libs/spaces-shared/src/space-log-messages.ts) | SpaceEvent has no rename variant, although other contexts show the space name. Do not invent SpaceNameChanged. | Spaces + Friends + App |
| MemberJoined / MemberLeft | [space-log-messages.ts](../../libs/spaces-shared/src/space-log-messages.ts) | PersonJoined / PersonLeft are published facts; room-log membership and visible presence may have different timing. | Spaces + consuming contexts |
| prepareExport / eraseAccount / withdrawAccount / expireExport | [messages.ts](../../libs/account-privacy-shared/src/messages.ts) | Internal privacy jobs, not new public lifecycle events. AccountDeletionConfirmed is the externally settled withdrawal fact. | Identity + Billing + Spaces + Friends + Chess |
| Avatar or permission-policy change | [profile feature](../../libs/profile-shared/src/feature.ts), [permission policy](../../libs/permissions-shared/src/permission-policy.ts) | No exact event name exists in the published event modules; dependent displays and open denial surfaces still need a boundary decision. | Identity / App + every affected context |

The important unresolved interruption cases are account deletion while checkout or a confirmation is open, loss of paid access while requesting another space/puzzle, a block while an invitation or opponent search is in use, and space ending while a watcher is offline. Existing charts expose known outcomes; they do not claim an unreviewed modal closes automatically.
